habitat: Shallow brackish water and saltpans, feeding mainly on algae at the water surface.
summary: Newman calls it a locally abundant nomadic resident and a visitor from other parts of Africa. A pink bird with red wing feathers, bill and legs, though birds can be quite white. The description says the bill is evenly dark maroon and looks black at a distance, and that it is pinker and more evenly coloured than Greater Flamingo. In flight the wing coverts look mottled with dark red. The immature is dull grey-brown. Newman does not describe the voice. Newman’s page uses Phoenicopterus minor. This file keeps Phoeniconaias minor. Status and months are unset. The Kemp code NB was left unchanged.

similar.note: Greater Flamingo is taller and whiter, with a pink bill tipped black, not a dark maroon bill.

research.note: Newman says locally abundant nomadic resident and visitor, so status and monthsPresent are unset. The colour key says a red bill and the description says dark maroon, looking black, which is why this needs review. Population figures and the Kemp code NB were left unchanged. SABAP1 describes long movements as breeding pans dry out, so status stays omitted.
